scripts.dev: concurrently -n rules,server,web -c "yellow,green,blue" "npm run -w rules build:watch" "npm run -w server dev" "npm run -w web dev"
scripts.dev:server:standalone: concurrently -n rules,server -c "yellow,green" "npm run -w rules build:watch" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run -w rules build && npm run -w server build && npm run -w web typecheck && npm run -w web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w rules typecheck && npm run -w server typecheck && npm run -w web typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
